description: This file implements IOSurface-based surfaces for macOS using OpenGL CGL, including texture binding, framebuffer creation, and format handling for IOSurfaces in ANGLE project.

classes.name: IOSurfaceSurfaceCGL
classes.description: Class managing IOSurface textures and surfaces on macOS using CGL, including binding textures, initializing alpha channels, and creating framebuffers.

classes.name: IOSurfaceFramebuffer
classes.description: Framebuffer class that deletes associated textures upon destruction.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds an IOSurface as a texture in OpenGL context.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a framebuffer with IOSurface texture attached.

methods.name: initializeAlphaChannel
methods.description: Initializes alpha channel for IOSurface texture if not already initialized.
